I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest from this conversation. I don't have a scheduling tool here, so nothing would fire tomorrow morning.

Two options:
- **Ask me each morning.** Say "Coastal digest" and I'll DM you what's new in #coastal-team since the last one you got.
- **Set up a scheduled job through your workspace admin** if you want it fully automatic. They can point it at the same #coastal-team read.

Which do you want?
